subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He claims to be the __________ kid in the school.
solution:
The correct answer is **smartest.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **S**martest.
 
• The word Smartest is a superlative degree.
 
• The boy talked about the **whole school** so that the correct answer would be **Smartest.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• There are **three types** of degrees.
 
• **Positive Degree **- This offers no comparison. It just tells us about the existence of a quality. 
 
 
• **Examples - **S*low, beautiful, happy*
 
 
 
• *​***Comparative Degree - **This compares two things to show which has the lesser or greater degree of quality.
 
 
• **Examples - ***slower, more beautiful, happier *
 
 
 
• **Superlative Degree - **This compares more than two things to show which has the least or greatest degree of quality.
 
 
• **Examples-** *slowest, most beautiful, happiest*
